verdict.reason: Almagreira is worth a quick check for mid-morning — 11:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide is part of the picture, but not the deciding factor.

conversationalSummary.text: Today, Almagreira around the mid-morning is the best bet, but it’s a rare, small window and the wind looks like it could turn it messy. I’d check the Surfline cams and MEO Beachcam first—if it doesn’t look noticeably cleaner than expected, I’d skip and save the drive. With the tide sitting near high and starting to fall, you might get something workable, but it’ll be touch-and-go. Go only if the cams show it’s actually holding together.
